```{r}
library(agricolae)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}

yield_1 <- read_excel("./data/yield_data_analysis.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names() 

yield1_longer <- yield_1 %>%
  pivot_longer(cols =  "ngpc":"yield_estimation_bu_ac_1",
               names_to = "variables",
               values_to = "values")

yield_midville <- read_excel("./data/yield_midville.xlsx") %>%
  clean_names()

```

```{r}

boxplot <- ggplot(data = yield_1,
                  aes( x = id,
                       y = yield_kg_ha_1,
                       color = ntreat)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = TRUE) +
  geom_jitter() +
  facet_wrap(~biological) +
  theme_classic()

boxplot  
  
```

```{r}
boxplot2 <- ggplot(data = yield_midville,
                  aes( x = id,
                       y = yield_kg_ha_1,
                       color = ntreat)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = TRUE) +
  geom_jitter() +
  facet_wrap(~biofertilizer) +
  theme_classic()

boxplot2
```

```{r}
scat_plot <- ggplot(data = yield1_longer,
                    aes(y = values,
                        x = id)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  facet_wrap(~variables, scales = "free" ) +
  theme_bw()

scat_plot
```

```{r}
box_plot <- ggplot(data = yield1_longer,
                    aes(y = values,
                        x = id,
                        color = biological)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~variables, scales = "free" ) +
  theme_bw()

box_plot
```



```{r}
dist_plot <- ggplot(data = yield1_longer,
                    aes(x = values)) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(~variables, scales = "free" ) +
  theme_bw()

dist_plot
```
